questions.question: What does rule coverage measure?
options: how often the rule predicts the correct class among covered records
Coverage and accuracy use the same numerator and denominator.
Every rule-based classifier must be built from a complete tree.
Coverage is the proportion of records that satisfy a rule's conditions.
options_en: how often the rule predicts the correct class among covered records
Coverage and accuracy use the same numerator and denominator.
Every rule-based classifier must be built from a complete tree.
Coverage is the proportion of records that satisfy a rule's conditions.
options_ar: عدد مرات تنبؤ القاعدة بالفئة الصحيحة ضمن السجلات المغطاة
يستخدم قياسا التغطية والدقة البسط والمقام نفسيهما.
يجب بناء كل مصنف قائم على القواعد من شجرة كاملة.

questions.explanation: Coverage is the proportion of records that satisfy a rule's conditions.
questions.explanation_ar: التغطية هي نسبة السجلات التي تحقق شروط القاعدة.

questions.question: If 40 of 100 students satisfy a rule, what is its coverage?
questions.question_ar: إذا حقق 40 طالباً من أصل 100 شروط قاعدة، فما تغطيتها؟
questions.explanation: Example: If 40 of 100 students satisfy a rule, coverage = 40 / 100 = 0.40, or 40%.

questions.question: To which class do correctly covered records belong when measuring rule accuracy?
questions.question_ar: إلى أي فئة تنتمي السجلات المغطاة الصحيحة عند قياس دقة القاعدة؟
options: when no rule matches a record
the test data selects a feature
options_en: when no rule matches a record
the test data selects a feature
options_ar: عندما لا تنطبق أي قاعدة على سجل
questions.explanation: Rule accuracy is the proportion of records covered by a rule that belong to the class predicted by that rule.

questions.question: A rule covers 40 students and correctly classifies 36. What accuracy is reported?
questions.question_ar: تغطي قاعدة 40 طالباً وتصنف 36 منهم بصورة صحيحة. ما دقتها؟
questions.explanation: Example: If a rule covers 40 students and correctly classifies 36, accuracy = 36 / 40 = 0.90, or 90%.

questions.question: How does rule coverage differ from rule accuracy?
questions.question_ar: بماذا تختلف تغطية القاعدة عن دقتها؟
options: Coverage and accuracy use the same numerator and denominator.
Coverage measures how many records a rule applies to.
Both measures count only records not covered by the rule.
Prepare the dataset by collecting and cleaning the data.
options_en: Coverage and accuracy use the same numerator and denominator.
Coverage measures how many records a rule applies to.
Both measures count only records not covered by the rule.
Prepare the dataset by collecting and cleaning the data.
options_ar: يستخدم قياسا التغطية والدقة البسط والمقام نفسيهما.
تقيس التغطية عدد السجلات التي تنطبق عليها القاعدة.

حضّر مجموعة البيانات بجمع البيانات وتنظيفها.
questions.explanation: Coverage measures how many records a rule applies to. Accuracy measures how often the rule predicts the correct class among those records.
questions.explanation_ar: تقيس التغطية عدد السجلات التي تنطبق عليها القاعدة.

questions.question: What do matching rules do when a conflict occurs?
questions.question_ar: ماذا تفعل القواعد المنطبقة عند حدوث تعارض؟
questions.explanation: Conflicting rules may predict different classes.

questions.question: What does the rule-priority approach prefer?
options: the test data selects a feature
the rule with the lowest coverage
options_en: the test data selects a feature
the rule with the lowest coverage
questions.explanation: Rule priority: prefer the rule with higher priority.

questions.question: What performance can rule quality prefer?
questions.question_ar: أي أداء قد تفضله جودة القاعدة؟
options: the rule with the latest position only
the rule with the longest antecedent
the rule with the fewest class labels
options_en: the rule with the latest position only
the rule with the longest antecedent
the rule with the fewest class labels
questions.explanation: Rule quality: select the rule with stronger performance on training data.

questions.question: How does voting resolve matching-rule conflicts?
questions.question_ar: كيف يحل التصويت تعارض القواعد المنطبقة؟
options: matching rules vote for a class
the test data selects a feature
the rule with the lowest coverage
each rule creates a new class
options_en: matching rules vote for a class
the test data selects a feature
the rule with the lowest coverage
each rule creates a new class
questions.explanation: matching rules vote for a class

questions.question: Which conflict approach uses the first matching rule?
questions.question_ar: أي أسلوب لحل التعارض يستخدم أول قاعدة منطبقة؟
questions.explanation: Rule pruning, rule ordering, default classes, and validation on unseen data can help address these limitations.
